Definition: an ephah or measure for grain; hence, a measure in general
BiblicalUsage: 1) ephah; 1a) a dry measure of quantity, equal to 3 seahs, 10 omers; the same as the liquid measure bath; (about 9 imperial gallons (40 l), rabbinical writings give sizes of one-half this amount); 1b) the receptacle for measuring or holding that amount
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
